none: PAS SWYOR-8BD5B9: Roman coin; denarius of Julia Domna
contea di ritrovamento: Wakefield (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman coin; a denarius of Julia Domna under Septimius Severus and Caracalla's joint reign (AD 198 - 211), probably dating from AD 211 (Reece period 10), PVDICITIA reverse type showing Pudicitia enthroned left, facing forwards, right hand on breast, left at side and cradling a sceptre. The obverse reads IVLIA AVGVSTA and shows Julia draped facing right. Mint of Rome. Compare Sear volume…
